changelog:
v1.1.0 — Switch to async image API; fixes "image fails to generate" on 2K/4K renders

  【Root cause】The previous version called the synchronous endpoints /v1/images/{generations,edits}. 2K/4K renders and complex image-to-image edits often exceeded 100s and were killed by
   Cloudflare's edge timeout (524), which users experienced as silent failures.

  【Changes】
  - Switched to the async API /v1/async/images/{generations,edits}: submission returns a task_id immediately, the client polls until completion
  - Polling: 1.5s initial delay, 3s interval, 10 min cap
  - Return value is still an upstream public CDN URL — no auth required, ready to render or share inline
  - CLI flags and stdout JSON format are unchanged; no migration needed

  【Verified】
  - 1K square text-to-image: ~10s
  - 2K landscape text-to-image: 62s
  - 1K image-to-image edit: 117s ✅ (would have hit Cloudflare 524 on the old sync path)
  - Error paths (missing token, invalid token, task failure, submission error) all surface clean messages and exit 1

  【Deprecated】1.0.0 and 1.0.1 are marked deprecated on npm. All users should upgrade to 1.1.0+.
